name: PiCamera component test plan
deployment: PiSensor full system deployment plus the harness component sysTester, prototype image (TCP); the test deployment of the project plan (SSDD decision D13)

not_covered_ack: Library error returns of the libcamera implementation of the camera interface (configure, allocate, queue request) that the bench cannot force: the unit tests force each through the camera substitute at the component boundary.
Refusals `BUSY` and `PICTURE_OUTSTANDING` and a dropped `acquire`: not reachable on the bench with one requester; unit tests cover them.
coverage.rationale: Baselines of the skill. Unit-test lines are measured on the component with the camera substitute; the libcamera implementation of the camera interface is measured on target only.

final_state.accepted_evidence: bench sha256sum of the L7-1 product file, taken over ssh after the run into record/raw/final-state.txt, compared by the auditor with the sha256 of the ground file in record/raw/files/
final_state.rationale: The bench reads the file itself, outside the UUT's reporting path.

scope: L0: desk-checked; bench confirmation pending. Marker `sysTester.MARK(U32)` -> event `sysTester.Marker(id)` as in the project plan. Event rate [I]: at most 2 events per second in any window (one capture gives CaptureStarted, ProductWritten and two command events over about 2 s; measured at L0-4). The piCamera channels are added to the heartbeat set so each window brackets them.
- UUT: `piCamera` in the PiSensor deployment on the Raspberry Pi 5 `soakee`, 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS 13; ground system fprime-yamcs over TCP.

- The picture is judged on the ground copy of the data product (picture record), delivered by `productManager` and CFDP; `CAPTURE`, `DOWNLINK` are `productManager` commands, `BENCH_LINE`, `MARK` are `sysTester` commands.
- Out of scope: the data product's other records, the RFM69 link, picture content.
entry_gates: - Unit tests of PiCamera pass with line coverage at or above the plan's threshold.
- Camera attached; its model and `rpicam-still --list-cameras` reply recorded in the SDD Introduction (a module libcamera does not support reopens the requirements).
- `dpkg-query -W libcamera-dev` on the target read once; a version other than 0.8.0 reopens REQ-PiCamera-017 before any run.
- Bench line CAMERA of `sysTester.BENCH_LINE` makes the camera unavailable and available without a process restart (driver unbind and bind, as project test L5-11); L0-3 passes.
- Image built from the manifest SHAs; L0-1 to L0-5 pass; product directory empty at the start of each test (teardown removes the products; L7-1 has no teardown).
levels: L0 provenance and feasibility · L2 functional · L3 restart · L5 fault paths · L7 final state. No L4: no requirement has an endurance bound. No L6: the component has no command to reject; refusals at its ports (`BUSY`, `PICTURE_OUTSTANDING`, rejected return) are unit tests.
not_covered: - REQ-PiCamera-003 to -013, -015, -018, -020 to -024: unit tests; the requester (`productManager`) sends one request at a time and returns every picture, so `BUSY`, `TIMEOUT`, `NO_BUFFER`, `PICTURE_OUTSTANDING`, `TOO_LARGE` and a rejected return cannot be forced on the bench.
- REQ-PiCamera-016: the build inputs are inspected; L0-2 judges the linked libraries only.
- A camera that stops answering during a capture (`TIMEOUT`) and a frame the library marks bad: not plantable on the bench without touching the ribbon cable under power.
decision_log: 1. 2026-11-17 designer — the component is tested in the project's test deployment (full deployment + `sysTester`), not a reduced one.

2. 2026-11-17 designer — REQ-PiCamera-001 'acquired after its request' is judged by two captures giving different picture bytes and by the capture time record against bench time (tolerance 2 s, project decision D12).
3. 2026-11-17 designer — max planted faults per draw 2; menu covers L2-1, L2-2, L3-1, L5-1.

5. 2026-11-17 designer — `picture_is_jfif` decodes the picture record on the bench with Pillow 11 (`Image.load()`), an independent decoder: bytes 0-1 FFD8, APP0 `JFIF`, last two bytes FFD9 with nothing after, full decode without error or warning, 640 x 480.
7. 2026-11-17 designer — each test runs once per harness process; planted faults that select a command by occurrence count from the start of that process.
6. 2026-11-17 designer — a restart window is split at its `sysTester.Started` row; the Pi clock is wall time, so a restart gives no clock backstep to split on.
4. 2026-11-17 designer — `BENCH_LINE(CAMERA, state)` is a bench line this plan needs from `sysTester`; reported to the parent campaign.

tests.title: Image identity
tests.purpose: Proves the running image is the manifest's image.
tests.evidence: require: Version events equal the manifest describe strings.

tests.title: Camera library identity
tests.purpose: Proves the image runs the packaged libcamera of the pinned version and links no OpenCV.
procedure: action: log `ldd` of the deployment binary and `dpkg -S` plus `dpkg-query -W` of the package owning each resolved libcamera and libjpeg library, over ssh, into bench-actions.log

metrics.text: upstream version (before `+`) of the package owning the resolved libcamera.so equals 0.8.0; every resolved library belongs to a Raspberry Pi OS package; ldd lists no opencv library

tests.evidence: The bench log lines; evidence outside the UUT's reporting path. REQ-PiCamera-016 is also inspected (build inputs).

tests.title: Camera line off and on
tests.purpose: Proves the bench can make the camera unavailable and available without a process restart.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera attached and free, product directory empty.
tests.evidence: Feasibility entry: covers no requirement, takes no planted fault; a `require` that does not hold makes the tests named UNVERIFIED. require (L5-1): first listing names no camera, second names the camera of the SDD Introduction; check: event sysTester.Started count == 0.

tests.title: Capture duration against trigger latency
tests.purpose: Proves a capture lasts long enough for the bench to act between CaptureStarted and the reply.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera attached and free, product directory empty.
procedure: action: on receipt of CaptureStarted run `date +%s.%N` on the Pi over ssh (the triggered no-op action) and log it into bench-actions.log

metrics.text: t(event productManager.ProductWritten) - t(event piCamera.CaptureStarted) >= 2 x (Pi time of the triggered action - t(event piCamera.CaptureStarted)) (require, L3-1 and L3-2)

tests.evidence: Feasibility entry: covers no requirement, takes no planted fault; a `require` that does not hold makes the tests named UNVERIFIED. The measured capture duration and trigger latency are recorded in the ledger.

tests.title: Camera holder acquisition
tests.purpose: Proves the bench holder process owns the camera within the settle time the fault test uses.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera attached and free, product directory empty.
procedure: action: start `rpicam-hello -t 0 --nopreview` on the Pi; log its pid and the time of its first frame line into bench-actions.log
action: stop rpicam-hello; log its exit into bench-actions.log

metrics.text: first frame line of the holder - its start <= 5 s (require, L5-2)

tests.evidence: Feasibility entry: covers no requirement, takes no planted fault; a `require` that does not hold makes the tests named UNVERIFIED. The measured acquisition time is the settle time of L5-2.

tests.title: One capture delivers one picture
tests.purpose: Proves a capture request delivers one 640x480 JFIF picture acquired after the request.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera attached and free, product directory empty.
procedure: wait CFDP transaction finished at the ground

metrics.text: picture record of P1 is JFIF, SOI to EOI, 640 x 480
bench time of CAPTURE sent - 2 s <= capture time record of P1 <= its completion + 2 s

rationale.text: counter counts from process start; only its change in the window is judged

tests.evidence: check: event piCamera.CaptureStarted count == 1; check: event piCamera.CaptureFailed count == 0; check: delta(piCamera.CapturesCompleted) == 1; check: delta(piCamera.CapturesFailed) == 0; check: last(piCamera.LastPictureSize) == size of the picture record of the ground file of the last product written.

tests.title: Two captures deliver two different pictures
tests.purpose: Proves each capture delivers a newly acquired 640x480 JFIF picture.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera attached and free, product directory empty.
procedure: wait CFDP transaction finished at the ground
wait CFDP transaction finished at the ground

metrics.text: picture record of P1 is JFIF, SOI to EOI, 640 x 480
picture record of P2 is JFIF, SOI to EOI, 640 x 480
sha256 of the picture records of P1 and P2 differ
bench time of the second CAPTURE sent - 2 s <= capture time record of P2 <= its completion + 2 s
capture time record of P2 > capture time record of P1

rationale.pred: sha256 of the picture records of P1 and P2 differ
rationale.text: sensor noise makes two frames of one scene differ; equal bytes mean a frame was reused

tests.evidence: check: event piCamera.CaptureStarted count == 2; check: event piCamera.CaptureFailed count == 0; check: delta(piCamera.CapturesCompleted) == 2; check: delta(piCamera.CapturesFailed) == 0.

tests.title: Capture after a process kill during a capture
tests.purpose: Proves the first capture after a process kill during a capture succeeds.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera attached and free, product directory empty.
procedure: action: kill the deployment process (SIGKILL), triggered by the CaptureStarted event
wait first Heartbeat samples at the ground
wait CFDP transaction finished at the ground

metrics.text: picture record of P1 is JFIF, SOI to EOI, 640 x 480

rationale.text: the first CAPTURE has no completion; the window requires STD-RST and the part B command predicates of the evidence line

tests.evidence: The window is split at its single sysTester.Started row: part A is the rows before it, part B the rows after it. require (else UNVERIFIED, the race was lost): A: event piCamera.CaptureStarted count == 1; A: event productManager.ProductWritten count == 0. check: event sysTester.Started count == 1; check: B: event piCamera.CameraFound count == 1, its camera argument equal to the identification of the SDD Introduction; check: B: event piCamera.CaptureStarted count == 1; check: B: event piCamera.CaptureFailed count == 0; check: B: event productManager.ProductWritten count == 1; require: B: event cmdDisp.OpCodeError count == 0; require: B: commands sent after the restart == count(event cmdDisp.OpCodeDispatched).

tests.purpose: Proves the first capture after a service restart during a capture succeeds.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera attached and free, product directory empty.
procedure: action: restart the deployment service (systemctl restart), triggered by the CaptureStarted event
wait first Heartbeat samples at the ground
wait CFDP transaction finished at the ground

metrics.text: picture record of P1 is JFIF, SOI to EOI, 640 x 480

rationale.text: the first CAPTURE has no completion; the window requires STD-RST and the part B command predicates of the evidence line

tests.evidence: The window is split at its single sysTester.Started row: part A is the rows before it, part B the rows after it. require (else UNVERIFIED, the race was lost): A: event piCamera.CaptureStarted count == 1; A: event productManager.ProductWritten count == 0. check: event sysTester.Started count == 1; check: B: event piCamera.CameraFound count == 1, its camera argument equal to the identification of the SDD Introduction; check: B: event piCamera.CaptureStarted count == 1; check: B: event piCamera.CaptureFailed count == 0; check: B: event productManager.ProductWritten count == 1; require: B: event cmdDisp.OpCodeError count == 0; require: B: commands sent after the restart == count(event cmdDisp.OpCodeDispatched).

tests.title: Camera absent, then back
tests.purpose: Proves an absent camera gives NO_CAMERA and the next capture succeeds without a restart.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera attached and free, product directory empty.
procedure: wait CFDP transaction finished at the ground
teardown: action: bind the camera driver over ssh (not a command, outside the planted path); log `rpicam-still --list-cameras`

metrics.text: picture record of P1 is JFIF, SOI to EOI, 640 x 480

rationale.text: the first CAPTURE is expected to fail; exactly one command error is a named check

tests.evidence: The window requires STD-NOERR; the command error count is a check. check: event cmdDisp.OpCodeError count == 1; check: first CAPTURE completes with error; check: event piCamera.CaptureFailed(reason=NO_CAMERA, step=DETECT) count == 1; check: event piCamera.CaptureFailed count == 1; check: event piCamera.CaptureStarted count == 2; check: delta(piCamera.CapturesFailed) == 1; check: second CAPTURE completes; check: delta(piCamera.CapturesCompleted) == 1; check: event sysTester.Started count == 0. check: piCamera.CameraPresent == false in the bracket after the first CAPTURE; check: last(piCamera.CameraPresent) == true.

tests.title: Camera held by another process, then free
tests.purpose: Proves a camera in use elsewhere gives CAMERA_ERROR and the next capture succeeds without a restart.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera attached and free, product directory empty.
procedure: action: start `rpicam-hello -t 0 --nopreview` on the Pi (holds the camera); wait the L0-5 settle time; log its pid
action: log that the holder pid is alive; stop rpicam-hello; log its exit
wait CFDP transaction finished at the ground
teardown: action: stop any rpicam-hello over ssh

metrics.text: picture record of P1 is JFIF, SOI to EOI, 640 x 480

rationale.text: the first CAPTURE is expected to fail; exactly one command error is a named check

tests.evidence: require: bench-actions.log shows the holder alive at the first CAPTURE send and after its completion. The window requires STD-NOERR; the command error count is a check. check: event cmdDisp.OpCodeError count == 1; check: first CAPTURE completes with error; check: event piCamera.CaptureFailed(reason=CAMERA_ERROR, step=OPEN) count == 1; check: event piCamera.CaptureFailed count == 1; check: event piCamera.CaptureStarted count == 2; check: delta(piCamera.CapturesFailed) == 1; check: second CAPTURE completes; check: delta(piCamera.CapturesCompleted) == 1; check: event sysTester.Started count == 0.

tests.title: Final picture for independent verification
tests.purpose: Leaves the final-state record: the last picture on board is the 640x480 JFIF picture received at the ground.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, camera attached and free, product directory empty.
procedure: wait CFDP transaction finished at the ground

metrics.text: picture record of P1 is JFIF, SOI to EOI, 640 x 480
bench sha256 of the product file on board == sha256 of the ground file

tests.evidence: check: event piCamera.CaptureStarted count == 1; check: event piCamera.CaptureFailed count == 0; check: delta(piCamera.CapturesCompleted) == 1; check: delta(piCamera.CapturesFailed) == 0; No teardown: the product stays for the bench `sha256sum` taken over ssh after the run. The hash equality is transport evidence; the picture predicates are the component's.
